## Overview

Versioned IFC PSD/QTO template catalogs.

This crate owns external standard-library metadata. Authored IFC property
and quantity instances remain in `ifc-properties`.

## Features

| Feature | Default | Enables |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `embedded` | yes |  |
| `generation` |  | `embedded`, `xml`, `dep:sha2` |
| `runtime` |  | `dep:sha2` |
| `schema` |  | `dep:ifc-schema` |
| `xml` |  | `dep:quick-xml` |

## Depends on

- [`ifc-schema`](./ifc-schema)

## Changes

Latest release, 0.4.1 (2026-10-27):

### Fixed (#537)

- The XML importer trims `DataType@type` and `reftype`: about 100 IFC2X3
  entries (`IfcBoolean `) and one IFC4X3 entry (`IfcDuration `) carried
  trailing spaces and so named no type. The embedded container, the IFC2X3
  and IFC4X3 snapshot pins and TSV exports are regenerated from the
  pinned sources (source digests unchanged).

Semver: patch.
